name: Midnight Riders

site.title: <Midnight Riders> · Alliance guild in WoW: Forever
site.description: An Alliance guild on a normal PvE realm in WoW: Forever. Guild night is every night from 8pm ET. Any level welcome.

hero.eyebrow: Alliance guild · WoW: Forever · Normal PvE
hero.lead: Level together, gear up together and ride out every night from 8pm ET. New, returning and 2004 veterans all welcome.
hero.alt: Tyrande Whisperwind charging under a full moon on her white nightsaber, Rambleon on her left and Cassidy Darkstar on her right

daily.plan: Dungeon groups, elite quests, mount runs, and raids once we're ready. Whoever is on rides out together.

tagline: Nobody levels alone here. Every guild night ends up in the chronicle, deaths included.

perks.title: Groups any night
perks.text: Post in the guild group finder and someone rides out with you, any time of day.

perks.title: Crafters and a guild bank
perks.text: A board of who makes what. Ask for a craft or a bank item and an officer sorts it.

perks.title: Guild chat on your phone
perks.text: In game guild chat is linked to our Discord, so you can talk to whoever is online from anywhere.

perks.title: The chronicle
perks.text: Each guild night gets written up the morning after, like a chapter of a story you were in.

perks.title: Fallen riders
perks.text: A channel just for how you died. The dumber the death, the better the reactions.

perks.title: Raids when we're ready
perks.text: We gear up as a guild and go in together when the roster is there.

leaders.name: Rambleon
leaders.alt: Rambleon grinning in his spiked silver helm
leaders.bio: Runs the guild and the WoW Forever Guide. Asks too many questions in guild chat and takes the screenshots.

leaders.name: Cassidy Darkstar
leaders.alt: Cassidy Darkstar in his purple hood with a crystal staff, riding a black nightsaber
leaders.bio: Climbing to 60 on stream with a clip from every session, and writing druid guides on YouTube.

steps.title: Join the Discord
steps.text: Anyone can join, any faction. Say hi and look around.

steps.title: Press Apply
steps.text: In #join-midnight-riders: your realm type, your faction and the character to invite. It takes 30 seconds.

steps.title: Get your invite
steps.text: An officer sends the guild invite in game and the guild channels open up for you.

faq.q: Do I need to be max level?
faq.a: No. Any level is welcome, and most of us are still levelling. Guild nights mix dungeons, quests and runs for every level range.
Alliance on a normal PvE realm in the US region. Ask in Discord for the realm name before you roll.

faq.q: Do I have to show up every night?
faq.a: No. Every night from 8pm ET is just when the most people are on. Come when you can.
No. Voice is open on guild nights and listening is fine. Text works too.
The form takes about 30 seconds. An officer usually sends the invite the next time they're online.

faq.q: My friend plays Horde. Can they hang out?
faq.a: Yes, on the Discord. The guild itself is Alliance only, but the server is open to everyone.

faq.q: Is this an official Blizzard site?
faq.a: No. It's a fan made guild page. World of Warcraft belongs to Blizzard Entertainment.
